# Local documentation link checker

Source: Ai-Eastern/reuse-before-build, commit 11d246336ef70826ef286613e154ec5deb308807.

Run `node scripts/check-links.mjs [directory]` to check local inline Markdown links. File targets and directories containing `README.md` or `index.md` are valid; directories without either entry document are reported. Run `node --test scripts/check-links.test.mjs` for repeatable positive and negative checks. This source slice excludes evaluation artifacts.
